name: Ieshima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ieshima town emblem in white: an outlined loop with crossed ends and a small disc, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Ieshima in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 December 1950.

features.role: Ieshima town emblem — an outlined loop with crossed ends and a small disc, like a stylised character
